name: @northwind/ui
description: Northwind UI: a small design system built on MUI (Material UI). Figma variables, DTCG tokens, an MUI theme, wrapped components, Storybook and agent guardrails.

scripts.build: npm run tokens:build && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.tokens:from-figma: node sync/checksum.mjs && node sync/snapshot-to-tokens.mjs && node sync/check-derived.mjs
scripts.check: npm run tokens:from-figma && npm run tokens:build && git diff --exit-code -- tokens src/theme/generated && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
